description: Opt-in behavioral checks for Charlie's Workflow phase gates.

cases.prompt:
$charlies-workflow
Track: feature
Interactive mode. Add collaboration to this existing application. Inspect the fixture repository, begin the workflow, and stop when the next user decision or approval is required.

$charlies-workflow
Track: feature
Tier: medium
Interactive mode. Add CSV export to the fixture application. The export must include the visible rows, preserve their displayed order, and surface an error when generation fails. These are proposed requirements, not an approved spec. Inspect the repository, produce the proportional spec, and stop at the required approval gate.

$charlies-workflow
Track: feature
Tier: medium
Autonomous mode, no questions. Add an audit-log view that lists actor, action, target, and timestamp; supports empty and failed loading states; and is visible only to admins. Make conservative assumptions, complete discovery, the spec, and the implementation plan, then stop before implementation.

$charlies-workflow
Track: feature
Tier: medium
The following spec is explicitly approved: add a collapsible navigation drawer, preserve keyboard access, show the selected route, and keep desktop navigation unchanged. Produce the implementation plan in this conversation and stop before implementation.
